exclude_images_by_frame_numbers: run the script to exclude specific frame numbers from an HDR capture dataset by moving them to an output directory
exclude_images_by_regex: run the script with regex mode to exclude images matching a pattern across all camera directories and resolutions
dry_run_exclude_images: run the script in dry-run mode to preview which images would be excluded without moving any files
move_file_dry_run: use the move_file_dry_run function to print relative source and destination paths for an image without moving it
move_file: use the move_file function to move an image file from its source path to a destination path using shutil
